sentences.text:
Appearance:
 Mohammed Imran Khan - advocate for the applicant.
 Shri Kshitij Vyas - Govt. Advocate for the State.

Order 
Heard with the aid of case diary.

This is first application filed under Section 483 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (in short "B.N.S.S."), for grant of bail to the applicant/accused, relating to FIR/Crime No.321/2024 dated (not mentioned) registered at Police Station- Balakwada Chouki Khaltaka, District-Khargone (M.P.) for the commission of offence punishable under Sections 363, 344, 366, 376 376 (2)(N) of the IPC and sections 5L, r/w 6 & 5J (ii) r/w 6 of the POCSO Act.
2. Prosecution story, in brief is that at the time of incident prosecutrix was minor below 18 years of age.
Prosecutrix left her house and met with the applicant and thereafter, both of them went to Gujarat and started to live as husband and wife for around 3 years.
Meanwhile, applicant committed rape NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-IND:31736 2 MCRC-41234-2024 upon her repeatedly.
Due to aforesaid act prosecutrix got pregnant.
She was recovered on 06.06.2024.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant/accused submits that the applicant has not committed the offence and he has falsely been implicated in the case.
It is submitted that there is no documentary evidence available in the case to show that at the time of incident prosecutrix was below 18 years of age.
However, at the time of incident she was major lady and she voluntarily went with the applicant.
She was also a consenting party for sexual intercourse.

It is also submitted that applicant Karan vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 8 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/177457643/
1 is in custody since 06.06.2024.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Investigation is completed and charge sheet has been filed.
Conclusion of trial will take considerable long time for its disposal, therefore, it is prayed that the applicant be released on bail.

4. On the other hand, learned counsel for the non-applicant/ State has opposed the prayer and prayed for its rejection, however, it is fairly submitted that no educational documents are available in the case diary to show that at the incident prosecutrix was below 18 years of age.
It is also submitted that as per the ossification report prosecutrix was 19 years of age as on 12.06.2022.

5. Having considered the rival submissions and after perusal of the case diary so also considering the facts and circumstances of the case, without commenting on the merits of the case, this Court is of the view that applicant deserves to be enlarged on bail hence, the application is allowed.

6. It is directed that the applicant- KARAN be released on bail upon NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2024:MPHC-IND:31736 3 MCRC-41234-2024

his/her furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the concerned trial Court for his/her appearance before the trial Court on all such dates as may be fixed in this behalf by the trial Court during pendency of the trial.
It is further directed that applicant shall comply with the provisions of Section 480(3) of The Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.
7. This order shall be effective till the end of trial but in case of bail jump, it shall become ineffective.
8. With the aforesaid, this application is allowed and stands disposed of.
Certified copy, as per Rules.
